name: Write novels in Japanese and Asian literary styles
description: Users asked to write chapters, outlines, or synopses for novels specifically in the style of Japanese light novels, Japanese short stories, or Chinese cultivation and xianxia genres. They provided detailed plot summaries, character profiles, and genre specifications—ranging from romance and school life to fantasy and isekai—while frequently requesting extensive dialogue, emotional depth, and adherence to specific narrative conventions.
